scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && npx pnpm build --filter shared
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:front & pnpm run dev:admin
scripts.build: pnpm --filter front build && pnpm --filter admin build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter front typecheck && pnpm --filter admin typecheck
scripts.ui-strings:export: node scripts/sync-ui-strings.mjs --app front --export && node scripts/sync-ui-strings.mjs --app admin --export
scripts.ui-strings:status: node scripts/sync-ui-strings.mjs --app front --status && node scripts/sync-ui-strings.mjs --app admin --status
